newsitem.title: UK: Malaysia tops UK bad parking league.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia tops UK bad parking league.

text.p: Malaysian diplomats have topped Britain's annual league table of foreign embassy staff who fail to pay their parking fines, the government said on Tuesday.

Malaysian diplomats had 71 fines outstanding, beating Bangladesh -- with 62 -- into second place. Next came Pakistan, with 61, Thailand, with 50, and Egypt, with 49, foreign office minister Tony Lloyd said in a written parliamentary answer.
But Britain's Foreign Office said it was pleased that embassies had paid 48,640 pounds ($79,490) in fines last year, more than four times the 11,600 pounds collected in 1995.
Among the countries paying up during the year was Nigeria, which topped the list in 1995 with 117 fines outstanding.
A Foreign Office spokeswoman said Nigeria had settled its entire 6,400 pound bill.
"We're fairly pleased," the spokeswoman said. "Our continued urging has paid off."
Embassy staff covered by diplomatic immunity cannot be legally forced to pay their parking fines.
But the Foreign Office writes to embassies urging them to pay and also collates the annual league table to "encourage" offenders to settle up and avoid unwelcome publicity.
